snippet.title: Galduen of the Void // Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863130/Galduen_of_the_Void/

A fantasy space agency management game! Manage your team, design your spaceship and research new technology! Reach moons, planets and the void beyond. Can you reach the void? Can you bring Galduen to the void?
